scope: Numeric magnet fluence, time-to-limit/first-swap, and swap-count margins. Generic fluence plots are excluded unless the plot claims a limit margin or verdict.
policy: A displayed margin must show its typed two-sigma interval and the verdict must use the unfavourable edge; when the stored state has no interval, show its reason and next step. Comparison deltas may show the two source intervals and an overlap/separation verdict, but must not fabricate an interval of the difference.
